note: Device quality tiers, presentation only (sim, hits, saves and spawns never read it). A signal is weak when the device value passes its limit; a signal the browser does not report is not counted. The tier is the row with the most weakSignals not above the count of weak signals. Row caps are ceilings: full is deliberately permissive so the older data files stay the source for the full game. frameMs is the median frame time after warmupFrames, taken once; frames longer than maxFrameMs (hidden tab, loading) are skipped. ?quality=auto|full|mid|low forces a tier (full is the off switch). distanceScale divides the distance used by the off-screen throttle and the hostile LOD, so weak devices thin and hide far actors sooner; shadowScale does the same for the ground blob shadow.
